original_record.question_en: Which new sections did the LP-WUS (Low-Power Wake-Up Signal) study TR 38.869 add to TS 38.211 and 38.213? (UE power-saving implementation)
original_record.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.869'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN tr.trNumber, ti.affectedSection, s.sectionId, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY s.sectionId

author_CQ_record.question: LP-WUS(Low-Power Wake-Up Signal) 연구 TR 38.869가 TS 38.211과 38.213에 추가한 새 Section은? (UE 전력 절감 기능 구현용)
author_CQ_record.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.869'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN tr.trNumber, ti.affectedSection, s.sectionId, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY s.sectionId

scope_rule: Both TS38.211 and38.213; actual new-section extent attributable to original LP-WUS study TR38.869, not merely manually declared NewSection records. Original four projected fields retained as evidence, no additional mandatory text field, arbitrary release cutoff or approved-only population invented.
